title: Official Forecast, Revision, Text, and Trust Feature Family
mission: Create the complete official-anchor feature family from all eligible forecast vintages and text, without outcomes.
steps: Generate first-to-latest revisions, count, velocity, sign, volatility and staleness.
Generate source/product/parser era and issue-hour features.
Tokenize/normalize weather, wind, RH and rain-probability text; preserve raw.
Define fold-local text models/embeddings; no full-history target-informed vocabulary selection.
Generate official-versus-causal-target-memory and official-versus-NWP disagreement only when counterpart features exist.
acceptance: All official features have eligibility and lineage
failure: Unparseable text preserved raw and flagged; never discarded silently
